record: W13-01 before-baseline for registry key test.ui.routes
why_this_matters: test.ui.routes exists only in the v2.0 registry today. Adding a v2.4 entry for the key flips resolution for EVERY selector on it, so the row that currently passes (task W13 with case C23, 6 assertions) must still pass after the binding, or the binding must disclose what it changed and the owning card of that selector must re-measure.
guards_observed: loose selectors (bare key, task-only, case-only) all return COMMAND_FAILED with zero assertions, which is the harness refusing to guess; zero assertions is never a PASS.
not_a_claim: this file records the state before the card touched anything. It asserts nothing about W13-01, its parent W13, or the formal cases C23 and A10.
